title: Regression tests for the defences, in CI

videos.script: Twenty-two lessons left programs that exit with a status. Each one is a test already. What none of them does is run on its own. {{title}} So the suite runs them together, and a failure may be known: it names a ticket and a date. Past the date, it fails like any other. {{suite}} The model is the harder part. One run each, two failures against three, looks like a regression. It is one ticket. {{once}} A hundred and twenty trials each, at the temperature the assistant really uses. Twenty-four per cent against thirty-two, and the intervals still overlap. {{rate}} So the build sets a ceiling, and asks to be shown the rate is under it. The candidate missed by a tenth of a point. {{ceiling}} And the answer to a red build is never to run it again until it is green. {{rerun}}
